items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: That was Clarence William's then band, Clarence Williams Blues Five.

ctx.x: That's true. He didn't want me to go, child. (Unintelligible) on the telephone, say, "William? I found Sippie." So we talked on the telephone. He said, "Are you sure that's Sippie?" He said, "Oh, yeah, (unintelligible). Yeah, this is Sippie, all right." He said, "If you're sure,

then we'll talk with her." And so then he (unintelligible) tell me about going to London. And so he was supposed to send me the money to come to Chicago to leave Sunday going to London. So the money didn't come. So I don't know where I got it from, but everybody say, "If you want to go, you go to London yourself -- go to Chicago yourself."
